info.title: SaintAugustin Auth Service
info.description: Authentication, user management, and role assignment for the SaintAugustin worship platform.

post.summary: Log in and obtain a Bearer token
post.description: Validates email and password, then returns a Sanctum API token. Include the token in subsequent requests as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Deletes the token that was used to authenticate this request. The client should discard the token.
Revokes the current token and immediately issues a new one. Useful for proactive key rotation. The old token is invalidated.

patch.description: Authenticated self-service update of `display_name` and/or `password`. Changing the password requires `current_password` and revokes all other Sanctum tokens for the user (the current session keeps working).

422.description: Validation error (bad current password, weak new password, etc.)

get.description: Returns all invitations — pending, accepted, and expired — newest first. Used by the Admin → Users screen to merge pending invites into the same list as registered users. Requires the `admin` role.

post.description: Generates a one-time invitation token and emails a registration link to the specified address. Requires the `admin` role. Returns 409 if a pending invitation already exists for that email, or if the email is already registered.

roles.description: Roles pre-assigned to the user on registration. Defaults to [musician].

409.description: Email already registered or already has a pending invitation

get.description: Returns the invitation details (email, roles, expiry) for a valid, unused token. The frontend calls this on page load to pre-fill the registration form and surface a clear error if the token is invalid or expired.

post.description: Creates a new user account by consuming a valid invitation token. The email and roles are taken from the invitation — they cannot be overridden by the caller. The token is invalidated after use.

201.description: Account created — user must log in to obtain a token

message.example: Account created successfully. You can now log in.

delete.description: Deletes an invitation, invalidating its token immediately. Requires the `admin` role. Cancelling an already-accepted invitation is allowed (it just removes the audit row); the user account itself is unaffected.

post.description: Re-emails the invitation link and refreshes the expiry. Requires the `admin` role. Returns 410 if the invitation has already been accepted (the recipient already has an account).
Sends a password reset link to the provided email address. The response is identical whether or not the email exists, to prevent user enumeration.

200.description: Reset link sent (or silently ignored if the email is not registered)

message.example: If that email is registered you will receive a reset link shortly.

post.description: Consumes the one-time token from the reset email and sets a new password. The token is invalidated after use. All existing Sanctum tokens for the user are revoked.

200.description: Password updated — user must log in again

422.description: Invalid or expired token, or validation error

get.description: Returns a paginated list of playlist summaries. Items are not hydrated — fetch a single playlist by ID to get its items. Supports filtering by name search, tag, and ownership.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term matched against playlist name (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: When true, return only playlists owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new playlist owned by the authenticated user. Any authenticated role may create playlists.

get.description: Returns the full playlist including all items with their referenced songs.

put.description: Updates the metadata (name, event_date, tags) of an existing playlist. Requires ownership or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

delete.description: Permanently deletes a playlist along with its items and share links (cascade). Requires ownership or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

post.description: Creates an independent copy of the playlist. Items (including target keys and notes) are cloned; share links are not. The caller becomes the owner of the copy. Any authenticated user may duplicate any visible playlist.

get.description: Downloads a formatted song list for the playlist. The `format` query parameter controls the output: `pdf` (default) renders a printable PDF via DomPDF; `txt` returns a plain-text setlist. Each entry contains the song title, author, and key (target key if set, otherwise original key). Lyrics and chord charts are not included. Any authenticated user may export any playlist.

post.summary: Add a song to a playlist
post.description: Inserts a song into the playlist at the given position (defaults to end). Subsequent items shift down by one. Requires ownership or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

put.description: Updates the `target_key` and/or `notes` on an existing playlist item. Sending `null` for either field clears it. Requires ownership or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

delete.summary: Remove a song from a playlist
delete.description: Deletes the item and compacts the position sequence so there are no gaps. Requires ownership or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

put.summary: Reorder all items in a playlist
put.description: Accepts an ordered array of every item UUID in the playlist. The array index becomes the new zero-based position. The submitted set must exactly match the current item set — no missing IDs, no foreign IDs. Requires ownership or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

422.description: Item set mismatch or validation error

get.description: Returns all share links (including revoked and expired) for the given playlist, ordered newest first. Requires ownership or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

post.description: Generates a new URL-safe token that grants public read access to the playlist. `mode` controls the payload shape: `musician` includes full song lyrics and preview URLs; `projection` includes lyrics but omits preview URLs. Requires ownership or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

delete.description: Soft-revokes the share link by setting `revoked_at`. The token becomes immediately unusable but the row is retained for audit purposes. Requires ownership of the associated playlist or the `admin` role.

403.description: Not the playlist owner or admin

get.description: No authentication required. Returns the playlist payload shaped for the link's `mode`. A flat 404 is returned for any token that is invalid, revoked, or expired — the response gives no indication of which condition applies. Rate-limited to 60 requests per minute.

Returns a paginated list of songs. Supports full-text search across title, author, lyrics, and tags, plus filtering by songbook, key, and tag. Soft-deleted songs are excluded by default; pass `trashed=only` to list only soft-deleted songs (admin view) or `trashed=with` to include them.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Filter by original key (e.g. C, Am, F#)

post.description: Creates a new song. Requires the `admin` or `musician` role. The `songbook_id` must reference an existing songbook.

put.description: Updates an existing song. Requires the `admin` or `musician` role. The `version` field increments automatically on every update (SRS NFR-8 audit trail).

delete.description: Soft-deletes a song. The record is retained for 30 days and can be restored via `POST /songs/{id}/restore`. Requires the `admin` role.

post.description: Restores a song that was previously soft-deleted. Requires the `admin` role.

post.summary: Import (or preview) songs from a VideoPsalm `.vpagd` archive
post.description: Accepts a multipart upload of a `.vpagd` file. With `dry_run=true` the parser returns the song list without writing anything; without it (or with `dry_run=false`), the songs are persisted and the response reports `created` / `skipped` counts. Songs are de-duplicated by case-insensitive (title, songbook) — re-running a previous import skips existing rows rather than overwriting hand-edits. Requires the `admin` role.

file.description: The `.vpagd` archive (a ZIP of Song_*.json files).

dry_run.description: If true, only parse and return preview rows; nothing is persisted.

guids.description: Optional Guid filter — only songs whose Guid is in the list are imported.

200.description: Preview (dry run) — list of songs that would be imported, plus a per-songbook count.

201.description: Import committed — counts of created/skipped songs.

422.description: File missing, too large, or unparseable

get.description: Returns metadata for every sheet attached to the given song. Each entry includes a short-lived presigned `url` for inline viewing/download.

post.description: Uploads a PDF or image (PNG/JPEG/WebP) and attaches it to the song. Multipart form-data; the file goes in the `file` field. Max 10 MiB.

get.description: Returns metadata for a single sheet plus a fresh presigned `url`. Use this when the URL on a previously fetched record has expired.

delete.description: Hard-deletes the sheet record and removes the underlying file from object storage. Requires the `admin` role.

get.description: Returns every songbook. Available to any authenticated user so songs can be grouped/filtered in the UI.

post.description: Creates a new songbook. Requires the `admin` role. The `is_default` flag is reserved for the system-seeded default songbook and cannot be set via this endpoint.

description.example: Songs for Advent and Christmas services.

put.description: Updates name and/or description. Requires the `admin` role. `is_default` cannot be changed.

delete.description: Deletes a songbook. Requires the `admin` role. The default songbook cannot be deleted, and a songbook that still contains songs cannot be deleted — move its songs to another songbook first.

409.description: Songbook is default or still contains songs

get.description: Returns the current status and version of the Auth Service.
Returns every registered user. Requires the `admin` role. Used to populate the Admin → Users table.

put.description: Updates display name and/or roles. Email cannot be changed (it is the primary identifier). Requires the `admin` role. An admin cannot strip the `admin` role from themselves — at least one admin must always remain on the account, and self-demotion would lock the admin out of this very screen.

delete.summary: Remove a user from the workspace (Admin)
delete.description: Deletes a user account. Requires the `admin` role. An admin cannot delete themselves — that would lock them out of the admin screen.

UserResource.description: A user record returned by the API. Does not include sensitive fields like `password` or `remember_token`.

id.description:
Reusable OpenAPI schema definitions.

These are referenced via $ref across controller annotations so they are
defined once and stay consistent.

TokenResponse.description: Successful authentication response carrying a Sanctum Bearer token.

SongbookResource.description: A songbook — a named collection of songs.

description.example: Songs for Advent and Christmas services.

songs_count.description: Number of (non-soft-deleted) songs in this songbook.

SongInput.description: Payload for creating or updating a song. On create, `title`, `lyrics`, and `songbook_id` are required; on update, any field may be omitted.

lyrics.description: ChordPro content — chord symbols live inline in brackets.

original_key.description: Musical key (e.g. C, F#, Am, Bbm)

SongSheetResource.description: Metadata for a file attached to a song, plus a short-lived presigned download URL.

url.description: Presigned download URL — expires after SONG_SHEET_URL_TTL minutes.

url_expires_at.description: Null when the disk does not support presigned URLs (e.g. local disk in tests).

PlaylistItemSong.description: Slim song shape embedded inside a playlist item.

deleted.description: True when the underlying song has been soft-deleted.

PlaylistItem.description: A single song slot within a playlist.

target_key.description: Transpose target key for this performance. Overrides the song's original_key.

PlaylistSummary.description: Lightweight playlist row returned by the list endpoint. Items are not hydrated.

PlaylistResource.description: Full playlist with hydrated items. Returned by show, store, update, and duplicate.

duplicated_from_id.description: Source playlist UUID when this is a duplicate; null otherwise.

PlaylistInput.description: Payload for creating or updating a playlist. `name` is required on create; on update any field may be omitted.

DuplicatePlaylistInput.description: Optional body for the duplicate endpoint. Omit `name` to accept the default "{original} (copy)".

PlaylistItemInput.description: Payload for adding a song to a playlist.

song_id.description: ID of the song to add.

position.description: Zero-based insertion index. Defaults to end of list; subsequent items shift down.

target_key.description: Transpose target key (e.g. C, Am, F#). Overrides the song's original_key for this slot.

PlaylistItemUpdateInput.description: Partial update for a playlist item. Only `target_key` and `notes` are editable after insertion.

PlaylistReorderInput.description: Ordered array of every item ID in the playlist. The array index becomes the new zero-based position.

item_ids.description: Every current item UUID exactly once, in the desired order.

PlaylistItemCollection.description: List of playlist items returned after a reorder.

ShareLinkResource.description: A share link granting public read access to a playlist.

ShareLinkCollection.description: List of a playlist's share links.

mode.description: `musician` — full lyrics included in the resolved payload. `projection` — lyrics included but `preview_url` is omitted.

expires_at.description: UTC expiry. Omit for a non-expiring link.

SharedPlaylistItemSong.description: Song data in the public share-link payload. Always includes full ChordPro lyrics. `preview_url` is only present in `musician` mode.

SharedPlaylistResponse.description: Payload returned by the public share-link resolution endpoint.

sanctum.description: Enter your Bearer token. Obtain it from POST /api/auth/login.
